integrity: An unrestricted combinatorial proof and finite independent-coordinate checks are supplied; computer experiments do not establish the infinite family. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof applies to q>=3 and the order-q simultaneous translation on exactly two coordinates; other actions, binary alphabets, non-Hamming metrics, and the general ordinary Rips homology of lower cubes are not classified.
title: A two-coordinate diagonal-cycle reduction for multinary Hamming Rips fixed filtrations
